tenders.briefDescription: Conduct a detailed requirements assessment and stakeholder consultation to identify and document the functional, technical, security, usability, performance, and data management requirements of the proposed system. Prepare updated Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Software Requirements Specifications (SRS), and Software Design Documents (SDD) in consultation with relevant stakeholders. Modernize and enhance the public website and administrative management system. Establish an integrated digital workflow encompassing applicant registration, trainee selection, admission, training, attendance, assessment, certification, and job placement processes. Maintain a reliable, comprehensive, and non-duplicative trainee database containing demographic, educational, socio-economic, training, assessment, certification, and employment information. Provide role-based dashboards and reporting capabilities for the authorized stakeholders. Strengthen the monitoring of project targets, training delivery, attendance, completion, competency achievement, certification, employment, and retention outcomes. Support secure integration with approved Government systems, identity services, SMS gateways, email services, and relevant certification or employment platforms. Improve system accessibility, bilingual content support, responsiveness, usability, and compliance with applicable Government digital standards. Establish secure hosting, backup, disaster recovery, system monitoring, and operational support arrangements. Transfer the source code, database, documentation, credentials, and technical knowledge to the Procuring Entity. Provide warranty, maintenance, helpdesk, and technical support services for the period specified in the Contract.
